generationMethod: Each light artwork was generated in its own built-in image-generation call. Each dark counterpart was generated in a separate built-in edit call using its selected light artwork as the edit target. The Conveyancing light was refined once to remove pseudo-typography before its dark edit.
policyStatus: Active Marketing-only artwork. Do not reuse between Marketing sections or on Join or Modelling pages. Campaign JPEGs and social-card exports made from a pack hero are expected derivatives of that campaign artwork.

promptPolicy.light: Use the subject and medium specified per asset. Compose a shallow panoramic editorial artwork with all essential subjects in the central horizontal band. Use a coherent OPDA palette of deep violet, ink, warm paper and yellow with restrained mineral blue, teal or coral. No logos, words, letters, numbers or watermark.
promptPolicy.dark: Edit the selected light image, preserving its exact subjects, geometry, gestures, crop, medium and semantic distinctions. Change only the ground, ink values and pigment or lighting treatment for a deep violet-charcoal theme with warm-ivory details and retained yellow accents. No neon, simple inversion, words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
promptPolicy.export: Sharp resize with fit cover and centre positioning, then WebP quality 88. No compositing, retouching or programmatic artwork changes.
